title: Vintage Kodak EK6 Instant Camera - Untested - Made In USA

descriptionText: The Vintage Kodak EK6 Instant Camera is a classic piece of equipment from the renowned brand Kodak. Made in the USA, this instant camera offers a nostalgic glimpse into the past with its retro design and functionality. The model EK6 is known for its reliability and quality, making it a sought-after item for collectors and photography enthusiasts looking to explore the world of vintage cameras.
